AuditRecord.title: AuditRecord
AuditRecord.description: A sanitized, privacy-preserving summary of a completed photo protection or link cleaning action synced by an authenticated user.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this audit record.

summary.description: Sanitized human-readable summary containing zero raw PII or GPS coordinates.

riskLevel.description: Assessed risk rubric level before sanitization.

itemsRemovedCount.description: Count of metadata fields, visual redactions, or tracking parameters removed.

verifiedLocal.description: Whether the output was verified locally on the user device.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the audit record was stored.

UserPreference.title: UserPreference
UserPreference.description: User-specific non-PII privacy preferences and checklist defaults.

historyEnabled.description: Whether local and cloud audit history is enabled.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last preference update.

/users/{userId}/auditLogs/{logId}.description: Stores sanitized privacy operation audit logs scoped strictly to the owner user.

/users/{userId}/preferences/{prefId}.description: Stores user non-PII settings and export preferences.
